svg.title: SOTIF modifications: P2 and P3 modifications (WP-C-07)
svg.desc: Figure 3-2: 5 cards, one per WP-C-07 modification with priority P2 or P3. FM-07 Enforce the ODD speed bound (P2): today, speedTooHigh warns without disengaging, and only above ≈149 km/h; the ODD stops at 110 km/h. With it: Removes the high-speed part of SH-13 FM-08 Road-type / construction ODD restriction (if feasible) (P3): today, No ODD monitor exists: the item can be engaged on unmarked roads and in construction zones. With it: Reduces exposure to TC-05/TC-06; size unknown until feasibility FM-09 ML action plausibility and uncertainty monitor (P2): today, No confidence or OOD gating of the control action: an implausible plan is acted on. With it: Earlier take-over requests in TC-01…TC-05, TC-31; size to be measured on replay data FM-10 Reduced, speed-dependent lateral authority (P2): today, Torque limits are not speed-dependent, so a wrong lateral command at speed gets the full torque. With it: Reduces severity/controllability of SH-01; may increase SH-02 frequency (less authority in curves) — must be balanced FM-11 Restrict auto-resume from standstill (P2): today, After a stop the car auto-resumes when the lead moves off, without checking between ego and lead. With it: Reduces HE-03.2-type events from the intended function

Today and status texts quote WP-C-07, WP-C-04, WP-C-02 and the gap assessment; the build fails if a quoted passage changes. P1: before on-road operation beyond safety-driver testing; P2: before G5; P3: decide at G2.
